Lina G: Heads up — noticed a sudden spike in active_contact_count for acct 00432, health_score jumped ~30 pts in <2h. Anyone seen this pattern? :eyes:
Noah R: Yikes. Could be the new Intercom->CRM sync we flipped last week. We saw fanout issues in staging previously.
Aisha S: I pulled the contact timeline, looks like duplicates created by webhook retries + a fanout rule. Sample event IDs: `evt_8a3f`, `evt_8a3f_retry1`, `evt_8a3f_retry2`.
Noah R: Can you paste the ingestion log lines?
Aisha S: snippet: ```
2025-02-12 08:02:10 INFO webhook-handler processed evt_8a3f -> created contact c_998
2025-02-12 08:02:11 ERROR fanout-proxy timeout, requeue evt_8a3f -> retry
2025-02-12 08:02:12 INFO webhook-handler processed evt_8a3f_retry1 -> created contact c_998_dup1
```
Lina G: That explains the contact count bump. Health scoring uses unique_contact_count for recency weight — duplicates artificially inflate recency and engagement.
CS Integrations Bot: integrations:intercom-sync detected 112 duplicate-contact creations in last 3h for source=webhook | alert_id=dup-20250212-01
Noah R: Temporary mitigation: I'm going to add a dedupe check in the webhook path (compare external_id + payload_hash) and set a 10s de-dup window. Will also push a hotfix to fanout-proxy to stop replays.
Aisha S: For remediation we should: 1) dedupe current duplicates (merge contacts), 2) run a health_score backfill for affected accounts, 3) pause renewal_nudge playbook for those accounts until scores stabilize.
Devex Bot: playbook-runner: paused `renewal_nudge` for accounts flagged by dup-20250212-01 | action_by=Noah R
Noah R: Merging script ready, will run in staging then prod at 2025-02-12 13:00 UTC. Script behavior: merge by external_id, keep most recent engagement timestamps.
Lina G: After backfill, let's add a Console chart: "dedupe-incidents vs health_delta" and an alert when a cohort has >20% score variance in 4h.
Aisha S: Agreed. Also tagging Sales Ops to forgive any automated nudges that went out during the spike. @Sales Ops FYI.
Noah R: I'll follow up with Intercom contact to reduce webhook retries and set idempotency tokens.
Lina G: Thanks — will monitor next 24h and close if no new duplicates. :thumbsup:
